name: alps
description: Agent Lifecycle Process Skills: a process-based framework and reference model for defining, applying, and managing reusable Agent Skills.

interface.longDescription: ALPS provides a process-based framework and reference model for reusable Agent Skills. It supports selecting the appropriate representation, defining and applying Processes, assessing conformance, and governing lifecycle changes.
defaultPrompt: Select and apply the ALPS Processes appropriate to this task.
Define and verify a reusable Agent Skill against ALPS.
Assess an adopted ALPS representation and plan controlled improvements.
